ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 95% dark pixel coverage. High-contrast ratio (white-to-black) is localized primarily to linear abrasions and water-line interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark-pigment field across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white linear filaments on the mid-left lobe. Small white clusters (mottling) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical U-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of serrations increases significantly toward the lateral tips, characterized by sharp jagged peaks and irregular spacing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature on the outer margins of both lobes, transitioning to a concave sweep as the contour approaches the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white pixel aggregates are visible specifically on the distal tips of the trailing edge, suggestive of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four distinct, parallel, curved white linear disruptions (rake marks) mapped to the mid-distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-stroke rake marks on the left lobe and significant jagged tissue loss/erosion on the lateral-most tips of both lobes.
